description: P35 (plan M6-M9 §2.13, §5.10, decision 27): who walks the Mere's shores while the giant is there - at most two at once, one every 60-120 s, 120-220 m away, out of view, on a node of the Mere road (never by a placed fight that is not cleared). Ruin robbers for a giant of stages 3-4; ogre pairs and dire wolves from stage 4. Each entry's members pay kill XP for its first three spawns only (wander.drowned_steps.<entry>.spawns).
